show.description: A powerful billionaire returns after a decade in hiding, disguised as a poor cab driver, to test his son’s loyalty and uncover the betrayal poisoning his family. As insults, greed, and manipulation push him to the edge, Randhir Ahuja prepares a shocking reveal that will destroy illusions, expose true faces, and change their lives forever.
